'''"The New Naboo Revue"''' was a dancing show that performed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Holo-advertisements for the show could be seen throughout the lower levels.
